Subject: Orchid x Redwood - proposal: rotating microforums (short series)

Hi Tessa and Ben,

Thanks again for the intro at Inference Week. Orchid's partnerships team reviewed the idea we discussed — a monthly rotating microforum series where each partner hosts a 45-minute technical conversation + 15-minute live Q&A. Our goals: generate high-quality demo leads, share thought-leadership, and split sponsorship revenue where applicable.

Key proposal (high level):
- 6-month pilot, one microforum per month (alternating hosts between Orchid, Redwood, and 1 guest partner).
- Each session co-promoted; lead ownership agreed by registration form and UTM attribution.
- Revenue share for paid seats/webinar sponsorships: 60/40 (host/partner) to start; open to negotiation.
- Orchid can provide a $12k marketing development fund (MDF) to support ads and paid social across the series; we propose Redwood matches $8k.

I've attached a one-page scope and a draft MDF matrix so your ops team can see numbers.

Would love to sync this week for operational details (hosting cadence, speaker rotation, landing pages). Proposed times: Wed 10/7 10–11 PT or Thu 10/8 2–3 PT.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Partnerships | Orchid AI

Appreciate the clear framework and the MDF proposal. This sounds promising and aligned with our Q4 demand-gen priorities. We can meet Wed 10/7 10am PT — Ben and Grace will join to run ops and content.

A few quick asks for the kickoff sync so we use the 60 minutes well: 
- Can you confirm lead attribution flow (HubSpot capture + UTM vs. dedicated registration form)?
- On revenue share: does Orchid want to define pricing tiers for seats (e.g., free, $25, $75)? We should agree a baseline so the split is predictable.
- Any restrictions on reuse of session recordings and lead nurture cadence? We typically want 90 days of joint nurture then platform-specific follow-ups.

I'll add a short agenda to the calendar invite and bring our draft revenue-share term sheet.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.
